Black and white rhino, with an anti-poaching team using cameras and helicopter patrols
No reserve-wide network is described for the field operation
context: Buffalo Kloof carries black and white rhino, cheetah reintroduction and a dedicated anti-poaching team across the Kowie River valley. The connectivity that is described stops at the camp's living area. We propose one backbone that belongs to the reserve and reaches the field.
security_note: Surveillance cameras, helicopter patrols and tracking already run on Buffalo Kloof. An owned backbone carries that data and ranger communications on one monitored network, day and night.
